tweets.body: @BlackHC @honorablepicnic I agree with you if they had shown that. I'm just pointing out they never showed this silent steering approach can't for example introduce subtle bugs so I have no reason to think that couldn't happen.. I'd rather have certainty on what I'm getting than an unknown behavior.

tweets.body: @BlackHC @honorablepicnic They said it "will not fall back to a different model" and it could silently rewrite your prompt or steer the model. If the reprompt is to "reduce performance for this query" it very well could introduce bugs which imp is far worse than explicitly refusing or routing.

tweets.title: @ziv_ravid Frankly I've found since coding became the top priority for LLMs, long-form writing has gotten noticeably worse. It's still good for non-native speak
tweets.body: @ziv_ravid Frankly I've found since coding became the top priority for LLMs, long-form writing has gotten noticeably worse. It's still good for non-native speakers, but I personally find I need to heavily edit or provide a first draft to get the succinct style of prose I want.
